$comment: Known Stripe deprecations. Every entry must link to official Stripe docs or changelog. 'patterns' are JavaScript regular expressions (as strings, so backslashes are doubled) checked against code with comments and string contents removed. 'stringPatterns' are checked against code with only comments removed, for things that live inside strings (URLs, element names). 'removalDate' is null when Stripe hasn't published one. 'methods' lists method names used to generate bracket-call patterns automatically. See README for how to add entries.

deprecations.deprecated: Sources API (stripe.sources.* in the Node SDK, or the /v1/sources endpoint)
deprecations.note: Stripe has deprecated the Sources API and plans to remove support. New integrations can't use it. Migration guide: https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods/transitioning

deprecations.replacement: Payment Methods API (e.g. stripe.createPaymentMethod() / the Payment Element)
deprecations.note: Removed from Stripe.js; calling them throws an error. The lookbehind skips the server-side stripe.customers.createSource(), which is a different method.
Removed from Stripe.js; calling them throws an error. Note the card element moves inside payment_method.card.
Removed from Stripe.js; calling it throws an error.
Removed from Stripe.js; calling them throws an error.

deprecations.replacement: Redirect to the Checkout Session URL yourself (window.location.href = session.url), or use Payment Links / Buy Buttons for client-only integrations
deprecations.note: No longer supported for client-only or client-and-server Checkout integrations.

deprecations.deprecated: Stripe.js bank Elements: idealBank, fpxBank, epsBank, p24Bank
deprecations.note: References to these elements now cause failures.
References to these elements now cause failures.

deprecations.replacement: Billing Meters: create a meter and send meter events (stripe.billing.meterEvents.create)
deprecations.note: UsageRecord and UsageRecordSummary were removed. The aggregate_usage price setting is its own entry (stripe-aggregate-usage). Migration guide: https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/usage-based-legacy/migration-guide

deprecations.deprecated: aggregate_usage setting on metered prices and plans
deprecations.replacement: Billing Meters: back the metered price with a meter (recurring.meter) and send meter events (stripe.billing.meterEvents.create)
deprecations.note: aggregate_usage was removed from all API endpoints. In stringPatterns so quoted keys are caught. Only reported in files that mention Stripe, since aggregate_usage is a generic name.
createPreview needs specific subscription details along with the customer; it can no longer preview across all of a customer's subscriptions.

deprecations.replacement: line_items: expand it when creating/retrieving the session (expand: ['line_items']) or call stripe.checkout.sessions.listLineItems(sessionId)
deprecations.note: Checkout Sessions no longer include display_items. In stringPatterns so quoted keys like "display_items" are caught too. Only reported in files that mention Stripe, since display_items is a common name.

Stripe's README says the project moved to @stripe/react-stripe-js and there are no plans for more major releases; the repository was archived on 2021-03-27. Migration guide: https://github.com/stripe/react-stripe-js/blob/master/docs/migrating.md
